This 2012 Ford Edge Limited offers a practical and versatile midsize crossover solution with proven capability and comfort features designed for everyday driving needs.

- Sony Premium Audio System with 12 Speakers and HD Radio

The technology package includes a Sony AM/FM stereo system with MyFord Touch, SIRIUS satellite radio capability, and CD player integration. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls allow convenient adjustment without taking your hands off the wheel, and HomeLink integration provides garage door opener functionality.

Safety features encompass a comprehensive airbag system including dual front and side impact protection, with electronic stability control and traction control working to maintain vehicle stability. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS offer reliable stopping power, while rear parking sensors and an exterior parking camera assist with maneuvering in confined spaces.

Vehicle is shown as is - sold as is. Client responsible for all repairs after sales.

This 2008 Toyota Highlander Hybrid Limited is finished in Classic Silver Metallic over Ash Gray leather and is powered by a 3.3-liter DOHC VVT-i V6 paired with Toyota's Hybrid Synergy Drive, producing 270 horsepower through an electronically controlled CVT and all-wheel drive.
